title: Remove unreachable GroupedPartSiblingOrderer dead code
description:
## Summary
`GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` (`Assets/Scripts/Editor/PartSiblingOrderer.cs:45`, static `Grouped` at `:68`) is confirmed unreachable: no code path can select it and it has no external references. Remove it, or wire a real selection path if the grouped strategy is still intended (state which).

## User Mandate
> "Synthesize the latest unreviewed audits and re-review the other recent audits from the last 2 days or so in order to extract all relevant information into the task system, or to improve the agent/skills/process/development pipeline aspects"

STRICT. Do not narrow or re-scope this requirement; surface any proposed change first.

## Scope
- Delete `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` and its `Grouped` property, or wire a real selection path if the grouped strategy is still intended (state which).
- Do not change behavior of the selected sibling ordering.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `grep` finds no references to `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` or `PartSiblingOrderer.Grouped`; whole-project build is 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- Existing editor part sibling-order tests stay green.

## Validation
Whole-project compile gate; focused editor tests for part sibling order.

## Findings
`docs/audits/audit-race-followup-and-streamlining-2026-09-11.md` confirmed an unreachable `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer`. Verified by grep at synthesis time (2026-09-11): it appears only at its own declaration plus the static `Grouped` property.

## Blockers
None.

## Next Step
Delete `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer` and its `Grouped` property if the grouped strategy is not intended.

## Reconciliation
2026-09-12 task-board review: the `SdfSamplingJob` deletion clause was removed from this record and transferred to `TSK-0248` ("Consolidate duplicate SDF evaluation paths"), which already owns removing the dead legacy sampler as part of SDF-path consolidation. This record now owns only `GroupedPartSiblingOrderer`.
